name: cOPDSzlib
short_desc: OPDS catalog for Readest that searches and downloads from libgen.
author: gxiang314
description: An OPDS 1.2 catalog that lets Readest and other OPDS readers search Library Genesis and download books directly. Searches expand Traditional/Simplified Chinese and partial titles, group each book's formats into one entry, and the root catalog offers Douban, Open Library and Taiwan bestseller lists. Includes a web UI with a download queue.

form_fields.label: Username
form_fields.hint: HTTP Basic username for the OPDS feed, web UI and API

form_fields.label: Password
form_fields.hint: HTTP Basic password; Readest asks for it when adding the catalog

form_fields.label: Public base URL
form_fields.hint: Only when exposed on a domain over HTTPS, e.g. https://opds.example.com — feed links then use it. Leave empty for LAN use.

form_fields.label: Recommendation sources
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated: douban, openlibrary, readmoo, kingstone, taaze. Empty means all; off disables them.
